meta.name: pr-review
meta.description: Automated code review using ReadLints and Shell for technical validation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审查代码质量并给出技术验证反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次合并代码前都需要自动化检查规范与潜在问题。
copy.tagline_en: Automate code review with technical validation feedback.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated checks for code quality before merging.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会自动在每次代码提交前进行技术验证：检查依赖、Docker、数据库和服务器是否就绪，运行类型检查和 lint，检测 console.log 等代码问题，最后生成审查报告和风险评分。
howto.when: 每次执行 git commit 命令时、推送 PR 前，或你手动输入“use pr-review skill”时触发。

say.text: 帮我对当前代码做一次 PR 审查。
say.note: Claude 会运行完整审查流程并输出报告。

say.text: 检查一下我的代码有没有问题。
say.note: 相当于触发 pr-review 技能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically performs technical validation before each commit: checks dependencies, Docker, database, and servers, runs type-check and lint, detects issues like console.log, and generates a review report with risk score.
howto.when_en: Triggered before every git commit, before pushing a PR, or manually by saying 'use pr-review skill'.

say_en.text: Run a PR review on my current code.
say_en.note: Claude runs the full review and outputs a report.
Equivalent to triggering the pr-review skill.
